QIST.definition: Quantum Information Science and Technology: the emerging interdisciplinary field of research and study looking to use the laws of quantum mechanics to make fundamental breakthroughs in areas such as computing, communications, and sensing.

SLC.definition: Synthesis Lab Competency (i.e. the final capstone project the course is building toward, integrating multiple foundational competencies on a full quantum-relevant system.)

FLC.definition: Foundational Lab Competency (i.e. elementary, assessable QIST-relevant lab skills students acquire as stepping stones toward working on real quantum hardware.)

FLC/SLC.definition: Foundational/Synthesis Lab Competencies (the structure by which a synthesis project on research-grade quantum hardware is approached via a hierarchy of actionable fundamentals on accessible, teaching lab hardware.
